meta.styleGuide: Warm, earthy, natural tones. Rich browns (#7A6132), deep greens (#2D5016), warm off-whites (#FEFBF3). Soft natural lighting. No harsh shadows. Watercolor/illustrated style for decorative images. Clean photography style for food/grain close-ups. Consistent warm color temperature across all images.

Some loose grains spilled on the table surface. A rough linen cloth partially visible at the edge. Warm earth tones throughout — rich browns, creamy beiges, deep golds. images.prompt: A dramatic split-image panoramic composition. The left third shows parched, cracked dry earth under a harsh sun — a drought-stricken barren landscape with dead soil patterns and heat haze, washed-out yellows and bleached whites. The center shows a gradual transition zone where tiny green millet seedlings are sprouting from semi-dry soil, symbolizing hope and resilience. The right third blooms into a lush, thriving millet field in full growth — tall green pearl millet and sorghum plants with heavy grain heads, rich green foliage, healthy dark soil visible at the base. The sky transitions from harsh white-blue on the left to dramatic clouds with golden light breaking through on the right. Environmental storytelling, climate resilience theme. Vivid contrast between drought and abundance. No text, no people.
images.altText: Split panoramic image showing cracked drought earth transitioning into a lush thriving millet field, symbolizing climate resilience
